set.body:
Scope
Build a template-conditioned probabilistic replay engine for encoding-to-recall studies.

Acceptance criteria
- Latent states include encoding fixation states and an item-independent background state.
- Transitions support stay, bounded forward skip, restart to a new chunk, entry to background, and return from background.
- Recall duration has a normalized generative role, such as a justified hidden semi-Markov or explicit duration-emission model.
- Spatial emissions are robust and use the same cross-fitted contraction/translation policy for every candidate.
- Background gaze is low-capacity, learned only from training data, and candidate-invariant.
- Forward-backward inference returns a normalized candidate likelihood and conditional state posterior with tested numerical stability.
- Replay coverage, encoding-state visitation, restart/chunk diagnostics, spatial residuals, and parameter provenance are exposed.
- Identifiability tests cover spatial noise versus background, restart versus chronology failure, warp versus noise, and template-length bias.
- Runtime target and complexity are stated and verified on realistic short and long scanpaths.
set.title: GW-3 Implement directional GazeWeave-Replay
